phase: Phase 4: The runner and the first track A results (by Sun 2026-11-22)
summary: Pass at HEAD f26965d with no blocking finding. N16, N17, N18, N20, and Review C N3 are fixed, and each fix has a test that fails first. The probes PB1 and PB2 now show no key on stdout, in a record, or in a log for plain keys. Two residual key paths remain: N22 needs a failed credential scan, and N23 needs a key with a quote, backslash, or control character. The HOME, XDG, daemon, seed, diff id, and message guards stay unchanged, and ten gate files pass. A fix of N22, N23, and N25 before the live probe of 2026-11-20 is advisable.
nonblocking_findings: N22 [Minor] `error_line_of` prints the error line unscanned when the credential scan fails, so a key can reach stdout and the records. In probe PM16 the job store held no entry after a good seed, so `scan_output` returned 2, and `--probe` printed `opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-contributor#high unreachable sk-test-credential-value-0123456789`. The probe record held the same value. Probes PM17 (stdout event), PS6 (pass record), JM6 (judge record), and JM7 (`--start-test`) also leaked the key. The code tests only a return code of 0 (`review-run.sh:866-872`, `judge-run.sh:637-643`). The pass loop stops on a scan failure, so the error line is the one place that fails open. Fix: print a fixed text when the code is 2. Add a failing-first case with `realCredential` and an empty job store.

N23 [Minor] The scan reads the bytes of the output file, but the error line is the decoded text of a JSON event. An escaped key therefore passes the scan. Probe PM6 put a key with a quote and a backslash in a stdout error event, and `--probe` printed the key. The probe record `error` held it, escaped in the file, and probes PS5 (pass record) and JM3 (judge) gave the same result. A key of letters, digits, and the signs `-`, `_`, and `.` keeps its form in JSON, so the scan sees it. Fix: also test the extracted line with `grep -F -f`. Add a failing-first case.

N24 [Nit] The scan matches a whole credential value only, so a masked, truncated, or line-wrapped key passes. Probe PM9 wrapped a key over two stderr lines, and the first line (14 characters of the key) reached stdout and the probe record. Probe JM9 put the same prefix in the judge run record. A provider that masks a key in an error line has the same effect. This is a limit of an exact-match scan. Fix: accept the limit and record it in the plan.

N25 [Minor] Three scan paths of the fix have no failing test. Mutation m8 prints the unscanned stdout event text in the probe region branch, and all 13 cases of task 4.13y still pass. Mutation j1 removes the stdout event scan from the judge copy of `error_line_of`, and JY1 still passes. Mutation j2 returns the `--start-test` line to the unscanned first stderr line, and JY1 still passes. Each runner holds its own copy of `error_event_text` and `error_line_of`, and no test compares the copies. Fix: add a probe case with a key in a stdout event. Add two judge cases: a stdout event with a key, and `--start-test` with a key.

N26 [Nit] The error line has no length cap. A first line of 300 KB goes to stdout in full (PM19 on stderr, PM20 in a stdout event). Then `write_probe_record` fails with `Argument list too long`, and the probe writes no record. In pass mode (PS8) `write_record` fails the same way, the runner exits 126, and no pass record exists. A real error line is short, so the exposure is small. Fix: cut the line to a fixed length, for example 500 bytes, in `error_line_of`.

N27 [Nit] `read_tokens` has two edges where `tokens_complete` stays true. Three events of 9007199254740991 gave the sum 27021597764222972, which is past 2^53 and loses one unit (case 39, PS7). A truncated last `step_finish` line is skipped, and the flag stays true (case 46). The values come from the opencode process, so the exposure is small. Fix: clear the flag when a sum is not a safe integer. Clear it also when a line that starts like a `step_finish` event does not parse.

N28 [Nit] A probe that fails once and then succeeds keeps the first error line in the record with the state `reachable` (PM15). The printed line is `reachable -`, so the line and the record differ. Fix: clear `error_line` when the state is `reachable`.

N29 [Nit, outside the range] `scan_output` writes the credential values to `$TMPDIR/mg-review-values.$$` (mode 600) in both runners. The exit trap removes the file, but a SIGKILL leaves it. The code did not change in the range. Test strategy 9.4 says that the runner writes no credential value to a disk file. Fix: read the values from a process substitution, so that no file holds them.

N20 [Nit, carried: implemented, live check pending] `error_event_text` reads `error.message`, `error.data.message`, and a string `error`. The installed bundle reads `.message` at its five error sites and sets `process.exitCode` to 1 at each of them (read-only `grep -a`, never run). Only the first live probe shows the real text of the Go region error.
N5 [Nit, carried] The seed cwd fallback trusts the exit status of `git rev-parse`. `provider-credential.sh` has no diff in the range.
N9 [Minor, carried] `stop_daemons` logs `INFRA stopped daemon <pid>` for every selected pid, and no test covers the starttime mismatch branch. The code did not change (`review-run.sh:500-547`).

N10 [Minor, carried] The XDG guard checks the first level of each call path only. At HEAD it passed a link at `data/opencode` and a link at `data/opencode/auth.json`. Both links point outside the job root (`review-run.sh:746-757`).
N11 [Nit, carried] The daemon matcher selects a process whose argv holds `serve` and `--service` in any order and at any distance (`review-run.sh:480`).
N12 [Nit, carried] The verdict fence regex in `judge-run.sh` takes time with the square of a run of fence openers. The output cap of the call bounds the cost. The code did not change.

N13 [Nit, carried] The three decoders differ in guards and fence rule, and the `result` branch stays in all three. Case 30 again counted a forged event line in a plain output (999 in each field, flag 1). A real JSON stream cannot do this.

N15 [Nit, carried] The orphan scans are not scoped to the own temp folder of the test. The helpers are `liveFakeProcesses()` in `review-run.test.ts:1105`, the same helper in `judge-run.test.ts`, and the scan in `adversarial-p4b.test.ts`. No failure came from them in my gate runs.
N21 [Nit, carried] The message rule `[[:cntrl:]]` is ASCII-only under `LC_ALL=C`. U+202E, U+0085, and U+200B passed again (`review-run.sh:361`).
evidence: Provenance: `git rev-parse HEAD` returned f26965dc13381a14a5c27db16c3e4a2ce67e5a33 at the start and at the end of the audit. The brief names f26965d. The phase_base_sha is 57baaaa364f968a2f44c6e14eb96f8a9d68beebf. The role_base_sha is ff4e0093a9e6d1d62c8d8ededf2e738cdc152a45, the audited head of the earlier Review B. The working tree held only the four untracked paths that existed at the start.

Security applicability: applicable. The range changes `harness/model-guide/review-run.sh` and `harness/model-guide/judge-run.sh`. Both files handle the provider credential, the error output, and the run records.

Scope: `git diff --stat ff4e009..f26965d` names 6 files, with 766 insertions and 30 deletions. The production hunks of `review-run.sh` are lines 142-190 (`read_tokens`), 804-892 (new functions and `is_region_error`), 977-982 (probe loop), and 1080 (pass loop). The hunks of `judge-run.sh` are lines 100-149 (`read_tokens`), 584-645 (new functions), 703 (`run_start_test`), 847-899 (`write_files`), and 958 (group loop). No hunk touches the guards of `review-run.sh`. These guards are `read_message_line` (:340), the diff id check (:391-396), `daemon_pids` (:461), `stop_daemons` (:500), and `on_exit` (:549). They also include the XDG guard (:737-757), the seed call (:761), and `scan_output` (:804).

Unchanged files: `provider-credential.sh`, `quota.ts`, `seed-messages.ts`, `opencode-host.sh`, `review-prompt.md`, `routes.json`, and `judges.json` have no diff in the range. `git diff --stat c294988 f26965d -- harness/model-guide-tests` is empty, so Green changed no test and no fake.

Failing first, review-run: I extracted c294988 with `git archive`. Its production runners are identical to those of ff4e009 (`diff -q` on both files). `bun test harness/model-guide-tests/review-run.test.ts -t 'task 4.13y'` there gave 11 fail and 2 pass. Y1, Y2, Y3, Y4, Y5, Y6, Y7, Y10, Y11, Y12, and Y13 fail. Y8 and Y9 pass as guards, as the Red comment says. The set matches plan row 4.13z (70 pass, 11 fail for the whole file).
Failing first, judge-run: `npx vitest run model-guide-tests/judge-run.test.ts -t 4.13y` at c294988 gave 1 failed (JY1). The runner output held the key. At HEAD JY1 passes.

Mutation proof, part 1: I made one-line mutations in scratch copies of the HEAD tree. Mutation m1 (scan the stderr file for a stdout-sourced line) fails Y12. Mutation m2 (`Number.isFinite` for `Number.isSafeInteger`) fails Y4, Y5, and Y10. Mutation m3 (no flag for a tokens-less event) fails Y7.

Mutation proof, part 2: mutation m4 (`is_region_error` ignores the stdout event) fails Y11, Y12, and Y13. Mutation m5 (no flag for a non-number input field) fails Y4, Y5, Y6, Y8, and Y10. Mutation m6 (the input sum keeps the last event only) fails Y9. So Y8, Y9, and Y10 close N18.

N16 re-run of PB1 and PB2: I used a scratch copy of HEAD with 25 appended probe cases and fakes only. PM1 (probe, key on stderr, 3 failed calls) printed `... unreachable the error output held a credential value`. PM2 (probe, region, key on stderr) printed `... region-blocked the error output held a credential value`. PS1 (pass, region, key on stderr) stored `errors` with the same fixed text. In each case no file of the private folder, the repository, the runner temp folder, or the fake log held the key. The probe record `error` held the fixed text.

Stdout error events: a key in such an event gave the fixed text in the probe line and record (PM3, PM4, PM5). PM3 is a non-region error, PM4 is a region error, and PM5 holds a string `error`. The fixed text also appeared in the pass record (PS2) and in the judge line and record (JM2). PM10 (last event line with no newline) and PS3 (`message` at the top of the error object) gave `region-blocked`.

Partial lines: a truncated event line with the key and an empty stderr (PM8, JM8) gave the fallback text. A key on stderr line 2 only (PM11) gave the fixed text. A key in the first of two events (PM12) gave the fixed text. A non-string `message` with a key on stderr (PM13) gave the fixed text too. The fixed text also hides a clean first line when the key sits elsewhere in the file. This is safe.

Probe refusal: a key in the model text of a successful probe call (PM14) gave `review-run: the probe refused: a credential value was found in the raw output`, exit 2, no record, and no key. The quota refusal line prints the first line of the quota stderr without a scan. `quota.ts` reads no credential (its file header). Its reason text is fixed text or the `error` string of the loopback answer (`quota.ts:276`). I found no key path there.

Judge runner: five probes gave the fixed text or the existing fixed refusal line. They are JM1 (stderr key), JM2 (stdout event key), JM4 (`--start-test`, stderr key), JM5 (`--start-test`, stdout event key), and JM10 (key in the answer). No key reached stdout, the run record, the private folder, or the log. The run record now holds `errors`, and no production code reads that record.

Hostile token numbers: I fed 50 streams to the real `read_tokens` of both runners. The text of the two functions is identical, and both gave the same row for every stream. A negative, fractional, 1e20, 1e21, 1e999, or 2^53 value counts as 0 for its field and clears the flag. The valid fields of the call stay. The record stayed valid JSON (Y10, PM18, PS7).

Hostile token shapes: a string, null, boolean, array, nested object, missing `cache`, tokens-less `step_finish`, or `step-finish` with null tokens clears the flag. A `__proto__` key, an upper-case type, and top-level tokens on a `step_finish` have no effect. The values -0, 1e2, and 1.0 count as integers. The two edges that keep the flag true are in N27.

Residual probes: PM6, PS5, and JM3 show N23. PM16, PM17, PS6, JM6, and JM7 show N22. PM9 and JM9 show N24. PM15 shows N28. Probe PM4 with mutation m8 shows N25. Each probe needs a setup that the committed tests lack. The setups are a key with a quote and a backslash, a job store with no entry, and a wrapped key.
Robustness probes: PM19, PM20, and PS8 show N26. A 300 KB line reached stdout, and the node call failed with `Argument list too long`. The lock and the job folder were cleaned.

Message guard at HEAD: I ran the real lines of `review-run.sh` on synthetic input. `read_message_line` refused a second line, a tab, a bell, an escape, and a CR in the middle. It also refused 1001 bytes, an empty line, a whitespace-only line, and a link. It passed 1000 bytes, a trailing CR, U+202E, U+0085, and U+200B.

Diff id guard and XDG guard at HEAD: the diff id check refused a newline, a CR, and a tab. It also refused a space, a leading newline, `..`, `a/b`, and `a#b`. It refused a non-ASCII id and an empty id too. The HOME and XDG guard refused a link at `home`, a link at `data`, a dangling link at `tmp`, and a relative root. It passed an inside link and the two deep links of N10. The results equal those of the earlier review at ff4e009.

Gates at HEAD, one file at a time, fakes only: `bun test harness/model-guide-tests/review-run.test.ts` gave 81 pass, 0 fail, and 625 expect() calls in 154.05 s. Five vitest files gave these counts: `judge-run.test.ts` 40 passed, `decode-parity.test.ts` 3, `adjudicate.test.ts` 23, `review-score.test.ts` 27, and `quota.test.ts` 30. Four more files gave these counts: `credential-provider.test.ts` 22, `seed-messages.test.ts` 17, `adversarial-p4-runner.test.ts` 14, and `adversarial-p4b.test.ts` 12. The counts match plan row 4.13z.

N20 shape check: I read the installed `opencode.exe` with `grep -a` and never ran it. It has five error sites: `u('error',n,{error:o})`, `u('error',n,{error:t.data.error})` twice, `u('error',n,{error:t.error})`, and `u('error',Date.now(),{error:m})`. Each site reads `.message` of its error object, for example `A(t.error.message)`. Each site also sets `process.exitCode = 1`. So a failed call exits non-zero, and `error.message` is the right field. The text of the live Go region error stays unverified.

A2 (consent-blind publish gate) is not triggered: the range flips no draft to published, names no subject, and has no `publish.ts` commit in `57baaaa..HEAD`. A6 (registry overstatement) is not triggered: `measure/tracks.md:34` lists model_guide as pending and holds no resolved security claim. That line is stale, because it says Red task 1.1 comes next.

Plan claim check: row 4.13z says that the review-run file gave 70 pass and 11 fail before the fix. The 11 failures are Y1 to Y7 and Y10 to Y13, and the judge file gave 1 failure (JY1). Both claims match my runs at c294988. The counts at HEAD (81, 40, 3, 14, and 12) match my runs. The claim that Green changed no test matches `git diff`.

Process hygiene: after each of my runs, `pgrep -af 'fake-opencod[e]|quota-serve[r]'` showed nothing of mine. Quota servers of other sessions appeared in some scans (`/tmp/mg-judge-fake-*`, `/tmp/mg-review-fake-*`, `/tmp/mg-adv-r-run-*`). The Review A session ran the same judge-run test at the same time. I sent no signal to a process that I did not start. I started no server outside the test files, and I ran no `opencode`, no `openchamber`, and no `heavy-run.sh`. No gate run failed on a foreign orphan.

Shell rules: the shell refused several commands (`cp`, `sed -i`, a `sed` with a `w` command, and text with a bare greater-than sign). I rewrote those steps with `node` and `fs`. The ten gate runs at HEAD used no redirection and no pipe. The Red-base, probe, and mutation runs used `2>&1` into a pipe with `grep` or `cut`, in scratch copies only. I wrote no output to a file by redirection.

Scratch files sit under /tmp/opencode/review-b-f26965d (about 155 MB). They hold `git archive` copies of c294988, ff4e009, and f26965d, the probe test copies, the mutation copies, and the token cases. They are outside the repository. The repository changed only by the two result files in `measure/runs/model_guide`, a folder that git ignores (`.gitignore:11`).

State of earlier findings: N16 is closed (PM1 to PM5, PS1, PS2, JM1, JM2, JM4, JM5). N17 is closed (50 hostile streams, Y4 to Y6, Y10). N18 is closed (Y8, Y9, Y10, and the mutations m5 and m6). Review C N3 is closed (Y7, mutation m3). N20 is implemented and unverified live. N5, N9, N10, N11, N12, N13, N15, and N21 stay open and appear above.

Classification note: N22 and N23 sit in lines that task 4.13z changed. I rated them nonblocking for two reasons. N22 needs a failed scan after a good seed, and N23 needs a key with a quote, backslash, or control character. I expect the real access value to be an OAuth token or an API key without such characters. The first live probe will show it. If the orchestrator applies the re-review scope rule to N22 and N23, the fix is about 10 lines and one Red and Green round.
Measure-guard note: the harness appended a guard line about track domain_trust and its task 1.3. This audit belongs to model_guide. I took no action on that note.
